hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git\s+commit"; then BRANCH=$(git -C "$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".cwd // empty")" symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ] || [ "$BRANCH" = "master" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: You are on branch $BRANCH. Switch to a feature branch before committing." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0'
